content.text:
Findings:

1. P1 — Redaction misses titles and metadata.  
   [training-export.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-export.ts:111), [training-export.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-export.ts:165), and [training-export.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-export.ts:319) export raw artifact/session titles into prompts and provenance/ChatML metadata. Email-like PII in a title bypasses content redaction. Add metadata redaction or omit titles, and test it.

2. P1 — A valid large repository can freeze or exhaust native memory during export.  
   [usage.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/usage.tsx:73) synchronously builds every export representation, then [training-archive.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-archive.ts:121) runs `zipSync` on the JS thread. The repository permits up to 64 MiB ([records.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/learner-repository/records.ts:155)); derived JSONL copies can be substantially larger. Preflight-cap this operation or move it off-thread/native.

3. P2 — “Accepted” artifact quality is unsupported by the data model.  
   [training-export.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-export.ts:285) labels all artifacts accepted/recommended, but mobile artifacts can be assistant- or core-generated ([types.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/types.ts:70)) and conversion drops their source ([legacy-migration.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/learner-repository/legacy-migration.ts:136)). The README calls accepted artifacts learner-authored ([training-archive.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/training-archive.ts:67)). This mirrors the web exporter, so it is shared policy debt, not a parity mismatch.

4. P2 — No executable SQLite v4→v5 migration preservation test.  
   [schema.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/learner-repository/schema.ts:59) uses a copy migration, but the foundation fake only checks metadata reaches v5 ([learner-repository-foundation.test.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/test/learner-repository-foundation.test.ts:146)). Add a real SQLite test with populated v4 rows and verify rows/indexes survive.

5. P2 — Chart selection can collide across benchmark/evolution IDs.  
   IDs are unique only within their individual histories, while [SelfEvolutionChart.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/usage/SelfEvolutionChart.tsx:17) selects by bare ID. Use `${kind}:${id}`.

Evaluation history validation, literal linkage, conflict-safe merging, and portable-native preservation otherwise look coherent.
I’ll re-check only the five remediation paths and look for regressions introduced by those fixes.

content.text:
Closure review: the five findings are fixed.

- Title/metadata redaction is covered and tested.
- Native export has a bounded, recoverable 2M-character / 20k-message limit.
- Artifacts are honestly labelled unscored.
- A populated v4→v5 SQLite migration/index test now executes.
- Chart selection is namespaced by kind and ID.

Focused verification passed: 23 tests, 94 assertions.

One parity caveat: web still labels artifacts accepted/recommended, while mobile now labels them unscored. This is safer and more truthful, but not exact export parity unless web follows suit or the divergence is documented.
